summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a periodic report on its buyback program. The company disclosed daily share purchases on the NYSE under the second tranche of a ~€3.5 billion multi-year buyback program expected to be executed by 2030. On June 29-30, 2026, Ferrari bought 15,638 shares at an average price of $370.85/share, for total consideration of ~$5.8 million. Since the second tranche's announcement, €137.9 million has been spent on 468,979 shares on EXM and 118,319 on NYSE. As of July 3, 2026, Ferrari held 9.29% of common shares in treasury (9.60% of total share capital including special voting shares). The cancellation of treasury shares approved by the AGM on April 15, 2026, has not yet been effectuated. This is a routine periodic buyback update with no special-situation event, but it falls under capital returns due to the ongoing buyback program. Watch for updates on share cancellation and remaining buyback execution.
